hooks.command: INPUT=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget).*\.(sh|py|rb|pl|bat|ps1)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Downloading executable scripts is not allowed" && exit 1; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget).*(-o|-O|>)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Downloading files requires explicit approval" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILEPATH=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive file: $FILEPATH" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILEPATH=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot write sensitive file: $FILEPATH" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILEPATH=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|json|md|mjs|cjs)$'; then npx prettier --write "$FILEPATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit 0
if [ -f .claude/context-essentials.md ]; then cat .claude/context-essentials.md; else echo 'No context-essentials.md found.'; fi
